headline: Reliance Home Finance Limited: 11th CoC Meeting Rescheduled to 24 June 2026
sum: Reliance Home Finance Limited (RHFL) postponed its 11th Committee of Creditors meeting from 15 June to 24 June 2026, as disclosed under SEBI Regulation 30 LODR requirements. The meeting will be held via video conference to continue the corporate insolvency resolution process.
detail: Reliance Home Finance Limited, listed on NSE, informed the exchange on 18 June 2026 that the 11th meeting of its Committee of Creditors—scheduled for 15 June 2026 at 3:00 PM IST—had been rescheduled to 24 June 2026 at 11:00 AM IST, to be held via video conferencing. The disclosure was made under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 30, and Schedule III, Para A, sub-clause 16(g), mandating listed companies to promptly announce material developments in insolvency proceedings. No reason for the postponement was stated in the filing. The company entered CIRP following creditor action under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016.
